housing-numbers.notes: Housing target of 350 dwellings per annum. Net requirement of 3,549 dwellings after accounting for completions (445), commitments (2,976), Peak District contribution (110), and shortfall (+80). Allocated sites provide 2,850 dwellings, small sites provide 1,200 dwellings. Chapel-en-le-Frith Neighbourhood Plan contributes 42 allocated dwellings plus 850 minimum requirement.
